claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Samsung ICR18650-26F as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell.
Steam Engine preserves Samsung ICR18650-26F 2600mAh 2C as a 2600mAh preset with a 2C runtime rating.
Published studies disagree on Samsung ICR18650-26F chemistry: one reports an NMC cathode while another lists LiCoO2.
The exact catalog entry Samsung ICR18650-26F has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2009-11-04 or earlier.
